name: Ovalbumin
role_in_food: Major egg albumen phosphoglycoprotein (54% of albumen protein, MW ~45 kDa). Undergoes rapid conformational change and denaturation under mechanical shear at air-water interfaces, establishing a viscoelastic cohesive elastic film.

name: Ovomucin
role_in_food: High molecular weight insoluble fibrous glycoprotein (3.5% of egg albumen protein) that provides native structural thickness to thick egg white and maintains foam cell wall rigidity.

name: Casein Micelle Complex (alpha-s1, alpha-s2, beta, kappa)
role_in_food: Colloidal aggregate of phosphorylated dairy proteins (80% of bovine milk protein). Sterically stabilized by kappa-casein 'hairy' brush layer; poor foam overrun compared to whey/egg proteins unless concentrated or acidified.

name: Beta-Lactoglobulin
role_in_food: Primary whey protein (50% of whey). Contains free thiol group (-SH) exposed during heat denaturation (>70°C) which crosslinks via disulfide exchange with kappa-casein, modifying foaming and gelling behavior.

name: Sucrose (alpha-D-glucopyranosyl-(1->2)-beta-D-fructofuranoside)
role_in_food: Lowers water activity, increases bulk continuous phase liquid viscosity by orders of magnitude, slows lamella liquid drainage via Plateau borders, and protects native protein structure from premature aggregation.

name: Potassium Bitartrate (Cream of Tartar)
role_in_food: Buffers albumen solution to pH ~6.8-7.2. Approaching the ovalbumin isoelectric point (pI 4.5-4.8) minimizes net negative surface charges, allowing closer protein-protein intermolecular association at bubble interfaces without collapse.

name: Milk Fat Triacylglycerols
molecular_formula: Glycerol tri-esters of C4-C18 fatty acids
role_in_food: At cold temperatures (<10°C), partially crystallized fat globules partially coalesce to form a continuous structural matrix that traps air bubbles. At room temperature (>25°C), liquid oil spreads on protein bubble films causing rapid foam collapse (antifoam bridging).

name: Type A/B Gelatin Polypeptides
role_in_food: Forms thermo-reversible physical triple-helical junction zones below 35°C, transforming liquid continuous lamellae into a semi-solid gel that completely arrests gravitational drainage.
